badgeCount.zh-CN: 自定义徽章内容的 snippet，代替 badge.count。
badgeCount.en-US: Snippet for custom badge content, in place of badge.count.

children.zh-CN: 按钮内的静态内容，代替图标显示；不能包含可交互元素。
children.en-US: Static content of the button, shown in place of the icon. Must not contain interactive elements.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩按钮，同 FloatButton；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
colorful.en-US: Colorful button, same as FloatButton. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

duration.zh-CN: 滚动到顶部所需的毫秒数；`onclick` 按此间隔节流。
duration.en-US: Milliseconds the scroll to the top takes. `onclick` is throttled by this interval.

icon.zh-CN: 按钮图标的 snippet，默认 IconBackTop。
icon.en-US: Snippet for the button icon. Defaults to IconBackTop.

onclick.zh-CN: 点击时的回调，参数为原生 click 事件；按 duration 节流，调用时滚动已开始。
onclick.en-US: Called on click with the native click event. Throttled by duration, and called once the scroll has started.

shape.zh-CN: 形状，可选 round、square；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
shape.en-US: Shape: round or square. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 default、small、large；未设置时取 FloatButton 的默认值。
size.en-US: Size: default, small or large. Falls back to the FloatButton default when unset.

target.zh-CN: 返回被监听滚动的元素的函数，未设置时为 window；返回 null 表示节点尚不可用。挂载时调用，函数本身变化时重新调用。
target.en-US: Function returning the scrolled element, the window when unset. Returning null means the node is not available yet. Called on mount and again when the function itself changes.

visibilityHeight.zh-CN: 出现 BackTop 需要达到的滚动高度。
visibilityHeight.en-US: Scroll distance after which the BackTop appears.
